question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa concludes the eight-tāla procedure?
premises: The section concerns the eight-tāla procedure.
The chapter is identified as the sixty-second.
inference: The sixty-second chapter of the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa presents the eight-tāla procedure.
plain_english: Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, on the procedure of the eight-tāla system, in the Aṃśumān-Kāśyapa.
